newsSince: Arteris added a July 8 IC-Link by imec collaboration to use its NoC IP in next-generation AI/HPC chiplets and ASICs. Q1 2026 revenue was $22.9M, up 39% YoY, with record ACV plus royalties of $92.8M and raised FY26 revenue guidance to $91M-$95M.

sources.label: AIP quote / market data as of 2026-07-09
Simply Wall St — AIP AI demand

verdicts.rankRationale: The imec collaboration is fresh and directly about AI/HPC chiplets. Record ACV/royalties and raised guidance make AIP a cleaner on-chip interconnect beneficiary than its old mid-pack rank implied.
verdicts.bull: NoC IP becomes core architecture as AI SoC complexity explodes; +39% ACV/royalties; widening automotive/edge design wins (NXP, Renesas).
verdicts.neutral: Strong thesis but catalysts already in price; +169% YTD, ~$2B cap, recent move is momentum not new news.
verdicts.bear: Tiny IP vendor, royalty timing lumpy, rich valuation after +169% YTD leaves little margin for execution slips.
verdicts.primaryCatalyst: Royalty ramp from AI-SoC design wins
